name: Harrier's Wood
description: The forest near Strixhaven where the students vanished.

timeline.summary: Dina leads Liliana and Ajani to the Harrier's Wood to search for the four missing students.
timeline.quote: led the two out of the building where Liliana's office was located and across the fields toward the Harrier's Wood.

pages_say.description: A lush forest an hour's walk from Strixhaven campus where the flora is considered magically neutral.
The forest near Strixhaven where the students vanished.
